approvalSource: Diamond FIELD FIX 01 最终发布收口
approvalQuote: 目标：尽快将返回商品中心、未建档商品搜索和桌面授权入口三项 L2 修复发布到 Production。

adaptations.app/api/native-inventory/[resource]/rout: Adds the stock overview GET and preserves the production salesTracking access response and profit API gate.
adaptations.app/management/page.tsx: Adds the receiver authorization link next to computer activation while retaining the production Desktop print settings bridge and its state handling.
adaptations.app/native-inventory/page.tsx: Adds the in-app product return and catalog selection, relocates pairing, and keeps the production sales-off banner and profit gate.
adaptations.app/native-inventory/stock.tsx: Adds unregistered catalog search and pagination while retaining production name/barcode searches, unknown stock, manual base unit input, and the adjustment guard.
adaptations.lib/i18n/en.ts: Adds only two English desktop inventory authorization strings and preserves production printing descriptions.
adaptations.lib/i18n/km.ts: Adds only two Khmer desktop inventory authorization strings and preserves production printing descriptions.
adaptations.lib/i18n/zh.ts: Adds only two Chinese desktop inventory authorization strings and preserves the production print settings title and descriptions.
adaptations.lib/native-inventory/service.ts: Adds owner-scoped snapshot reads and keyset pagination while preserving the old catalog response, sales state, nullable inventory and receipt/adjustment behavior.
